original.target_description: Experiment 1, older versus younger children on correct hidden-object identification in where trials. Study and outcome located, but no direct between-age test is printed on the supplied page or elsewhere in the paper. Printed one-sample tests compare each age group with chance; these do not establish the requested between-age contrast.

replication.target_description: Study 1 replication, independent-measures t-test comparing younger and older children on the number of correct where-trial responses. This matches the supplied age-comparison description, although the report identifies a different one-sample test as its primary confirmatory replication target.

n.sample_role: Participants in the between-age where-trial comparison (12 younger, 8 older)
n.exclusions: No exclusions reported; all 20 participants analyzed.

notes: The neutral description specifies an older-versus-younger comparison. The replication explicitly distinguishes this initially identified comparison from its final primary confirmatory target (older children versus chance on where trials). The original paper prints the latter one-sample t test, but not the requested direct between-age comparison; no substitute original statistic, p value, or generic study sample was assigned. The original prints p_rep, which is not an ordinary p value. The replication author verdict concerns the primary older-versus-chance result and is recorded as the authors’ narrative verdict, not inferred from the between-age p value. Both retrieved document titles match the supplied references; the OSF final report author list differs from the project citation. Replication page numbers verified using DOCX rendered page-break markers.
